firstMessage.content:
Hello everyone! I am considering a two-stage approach for this competition and wanted to see if anyone has experimented with something similar or has any insights. Instead of training a single model to predict all individual model variants directly, the idea is to build a hierarchical classification pipeline:

  1. Stage 1 (Provider Level): Predict the parent company/provider first (e.g., OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.).
  2. Stage 2 (Model Level): Train a dedicated specialist model for each provider to predict the exact architecture/variant. For reference, here is the provider-to-model hierarchy: • OpenAI: gpt-5.5, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-6-astra • Google: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-3.8-flash • Anthropic: claude-fable-5, claude-opus-4-6, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5 • Qwen: qwen3.8-max • ZAI: glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash • Moonshot: kimi-k3
